questions.questionText: I was still breathing out murderous threats against the Lord’s disciples. Who am I?
Saul went to the high priest for letters to the synagogues in which city?
What did Saul want to do to people of the Way?
options: Take them as prisoners to Jerusalem

questions.questionText: What happened as he neared Damascus?
options: A light from heaven flashed around him

questions.questionText: What did Saul do?
Who said, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”
Saul asked, “Who are you, Lord?” What was the answer?
options: “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.”

questions.questionText: What did the Lord tell Saul to do?
options: Get up and go into the city
Go back to Jerusalem at once

questions.questionText: True or false: The men with Saul heard the sound but did not see anyone.
options: True — and they also spoke with Jesus

questions.questionText: When Saul got up, what was wrong?
options: He could see nothing (he was blind)

questions.questionText: For how many days was Saul blind, and he did not eat or drink?
Where did they lead Saul?
I am a disciple in Damascus. The Lord called me in a vision. Who am I?
The Lord told Ananias to go to whose house on Straight Street?
Saul of Tarsus is praying at Judas’s house. Who is he from?
In a vision Saul saw a man named Ananias come and do what?
options: Place his hands on him to restore his sight

questions.questionText: Ananias said he had heard many reports about Saul. What reports?
options: How much harm he has done to the saints in Jerusalem
That Saul was a kind helper
That Saul was already an apostle

questions.questionText: The Lord said Saul is what kind of instrument?
options: My chosen instrument to proclaim my name

questions.questionText: What did the Lord say he would show Saul?
options: How much he must suffer for my name

questions.questionText: Ananias placed his hands on Saul and called him what?
What fell from Saul’s eyes?
What did Saul do after he could see?
options: He got up and was baptized
He ran back to the high priest
He went to sleep for a week

questions.questionText: Where did Saul begin to preach that Jesus is the Son of God?
How did the people react?
After many days, what did the Jews in Damascus plan?
How did Saul escape?
options: His followers lowered him in a basket through an opening in the wall

questions.questionText: When Saul came to Jerusalem, who was afraid of him?
Who took Saul and brought him to the apostles?
When the Hellenistic Jews tried to kill Saul, where did the brothers send him?
options: To Tarsus, by way of Caesarea

questions.questionText: Then the church enjoyed what?
options: A time of peace and was strengthened

questions.questionText: Peter went to visit the Lord’s people in which town and found Aeneas?
I had been bedridden for eight years and was paralyzed. Who am I?
Who said, “Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and roll up your mat”?
Who in Joppa was always doing good and helping the poor?
options: Mary the mother of John Mark only

questions.questionText: What happened to Tabitha?
Where did they put Tabitha’s body?
The disciples sent two men to get whom, because he was not far from Joppa?
What did Peter do in the upstairs room?
options: He sent them out, got down on his knees and prayed, then said, “Tabitha, get up.”

questions.questionText: What did Tabitha do?
options: She opened her eyes and sat up

questions.questionText: Peter stayed in Joppa for some time with a tanner named what?
My Greek name is Dorcas, which means gazelle. Who am I?
True or false: All who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw Aeneas and turned to the Lord.
options: False — only one person saw him

questions.questionText: Who showed Peter the robes and other clothing Dorcas had made?
This became known all over which city, and many people believed in the Lord?
I am a tanner in Joppa. Peter stayed with me. Who am I?
